Title: 3 Everyday Foods Behind Your Swelling (Sodium Alert)

Description:
Rings feeling tight by lunch and ankles looking thicker by evening, with nothing about your day to explain it?

Extra sodium traps water around your cells, and deli meat, canned soup, and beer are three of the most common everyday culprits - a few slices of deli ham alone can carry over 1,000mg of sodium.

Watch to find out why, and easy swaps that help.
